::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Luke portrays Jesus as the compassionate Savior for all people. The book emphasizes God's grace toward the outcast, the poor, and the nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Luke 1:37
For with God nothing shall be impossible
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted promises in Scripture ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the announcements of the births of John the Baptist and Jesus. The key verse highlights God's faithfulness in fulfilling His promises through His appointed Savior. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Luke 2:11
Unto you is born this day a Savior
### Why This Verse Central Christmas proclamation ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Jesus' birth, dedication, and childhood. The key verse presents Christ as the Savior brought for all people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Luke 3:16
He shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire
### Why This Verse John the Baptist's prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces John the Baptist's ministry and Jesus' baptism. The key verse calls for repentance demonstrated through transformed lives. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Luke 4:18
The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me
### Why This Verse Jesus' mission statement ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jesus' temptation and the beginning of His public ministry. The key verse reveals Jesus as the fulfillment of God's promise to bring good news and freedom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Luke 5:32
I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance
### Why This Verse Purpose of Christ's ministry ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains the calling of the first disciples and miraculous healings. The key verse emphasizes leaving everything behind to follow Christ. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Luke 6:31
As ye would that men should do to you
### Why This Verse The Golden Rule ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches about discipleship, love, and kingdom living. The key verse calls believers to love even their enemies. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Luke 7:47
Her sins, which are many, are forgiven
### Why This Verse Grace and forgiveness ### Chapter Insight This chapter demonstrates Jesus' compassion and authority through miracles. The key verse highlights faith as the proper response to Christ. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Luke 8:50
Fear not: believe only
### Why This Verse Jairus' daughter ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains parables, miracles, and demonstrations of faith. The key verse emphasizes hearing God's Word and responding with perseverance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Luke 9:23
If any man will come after Me, let him deny himself
### Why This Verse Core discipleship verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the sending of the twelve, Peter's confession, and the Transfiguration. The key verse emphasizes that true discipleship requires denying oneself and following Christ. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Luke 10:27
Love the Lord thy God... and thy neighbor
### Why This Verse Greatest commandment summary ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains the mission of the seventy-two, the Good Samaritan, and Mary and Martha. The key verse teaches that love for God and neighbor fulfills God's will. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Luke 11:9
Ask, and it shall be given you
### Why This Verse Famous teaching on prayer ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches about prayer and warns against spiritual hypocrisy. The key verse encourages persistent prayer and dependence upon God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Luke 12:34
Where your treasure is, there will your heart be also
### Why This Verse Heart and priorities ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses fear, greed, worry, and readiness. The key verse calls believers to seek God's kingdom above earthly concerns. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Luke 13:24
Strive to enter in at the strait gate
### Why This Verse Call to salvation ### Chapter Insight This chapter emphasizes repentance and the growth of God's kingdom. The key verse reveals God's desire to gather and save His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Luke 14:11
He that humbleth himself shall be exalted
### Why This Verse Kingdom principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches humility, hospitality, and the cost of discipleship. The key verse stresses counting the cost before following Christ. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Luke 15:7
Joy in heaven over one sinner that repenteth
### Why This Verse Heart of the lost sheep parable ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains the parables of the lost sheep, lost coin, and prodigal son. The key verse highlights God's joy over repentant sinners. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Luke 16:13
Ye cannot serve God and mammon
### Why This Verse Loyalty and wealth ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses stewardship, wealth, and eternal priorities. The key verse teaches that faithfulness in small things reflects true spiritual character. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Luke 17:21
The kingdom of God is within you (or among you)
### Why This Verse Frequently discussed kingdom verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches about forgiveness, faith, gratitude, and the coming kingdom. The key verse highlights thankful faith through the healing of the grateful Samaritan. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Luke 18:27
The things impossible with men are possible with God
### Why This Verse Divine possibility ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains teachings on persistent prayer, humility, and salvation. The key verse emphasizes humble dependence upon God rather than self-righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Luke 19:10
The Son of man is come to seek and save the lost
### Why This Verse Key summary of Jesus' mission ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Zacchaeus' conversion and Jesus' triumphal entry. The key verse summarizes Jesus' mission to seek and save the lost. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Luke 20:25
Render unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's
### Why This Verse Church and state principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains confrontations with religious leaders. The key verse highlights Jesus' authority and wisdom in exposing false motives. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Luke 21:33
Heaven and earth shall pass away
### Why This Verse Enduring words of Christ ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the widow's offering and Jesus' teaching about future events. The key verse commends wholehearted devotion regardless of material resources. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Luke 22:42
Not My will, but Thine, be done
### Why This Verse Gethsemane submission ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the Last Supper, Jesus' arrest, and Peter's denial. The key verse establishes the New Covenant through Christ's sacrificial work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Luke 23:34
Father, forgive them
### Why This Verse One of Christ's most famous sayings ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jesus' trial, crucifixion, and death. The key verse reveals Christ's mercy even toward those responsible for His suffering. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Luke 24:6
He is not here, but is risen
### Why This Verse Resurrection proclamation ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the resurrection, the Emmaus road encounter, and Jesus' final instructions. The key verse proclaims the risen Christ and the mission to proclaim repentance and forgiveness to all nations. :::
